question: On the exact accepted Incremental Backups source, which non-overlapping promoted-r24 construction stages own the 231.835710 ms child-create deficit versus ZIP, and is any one current stage large enough that eliminating/reusing it could close the deficit?
current_pipeline: Builder.scan including deferred nested-container recipe work

instrument.source: exact repaired neutral-hostile generation + accepted-tree guard + external normalization
instrument.timing: wrap only named current functions; use ordered_worker_pull wall as encoding critical-path wall rather than summing concurrent per-candidate CPU
instrument.residuals: derive Builder residual and promoted-wrapper residual only from non-overlapping direct stage walls
instrument.identity_gate: all instrumented/control outputs must have identical archive bytes/SHA-256 and release policy facts

existing_controls: The historical source-shape prewalk attribution/gifted-control family remains separately unexecuted and cannot be treated as a result.

Run109 exact nested-ZIP micro shows first-member Deflate-level reuse can eliminate 74.61% of exact recompressions locally, but its ~88.8 ms local CPU signal is insufficient by itself to explain the 231.8 ms hosted r24-vs-ZIP wall gap.
Historical R40/R41 Builder scheduling evidence is retained as a different scheduler family; do not attribute its small gains to stage elimination.
prediction: Nested-container scan/recipe work is expected to be material because the accepted Backup tree contains snapshot_2.zip with 192 Deflated members, but the experiment is deliberately stage-agnostic and may instead localize compression, scan metadata, serialization, or wrapper overhead.

decision_law.owner_large_enough: If one measured stage median is at least the full current 231.835710 ms ZIP gap, it can own the next exact elimination/reuse hypothesis, subject to a separate A/B proving that wall is actually removable.
decision_law.mixed_debt: If no single stage explains the full gap, do not threshold-garden a small stage. Search a composition only when causal coexistence is established, otherwise reopen representation/execution architecture.
decision_law.instrumentation_invalid: If instrumented/control physical archive identity or release policy facts differ, or timing wrappers materially perturb total wall without a stable correction, the attribution is invalid.

promotion_boundary: Research attribution only. Stage wall is not eliminable wall. No product/release credit without exact same-input candidate A/B, complete semantics, external controls and unchanged gates.
